lane: C3a PAL + FA true-to-model clamp/floor audit
classification_rule: docs/efv-2026-07-24/GATES-ACCURACY.md: (1) board-movement/display compression -> REMOVE; (2) accuracy-load-bearing -> KEEP w/ evidence; (3) numerical/domain safety -> KEEP. Default REMOVE.

classifications.clamp: _clamp(x,0,100) on the component ramps (command_score, stuff_quality_score, putaway_score, survivability_score, fb_reliance_inv, platoon_neutrality_score, astuff_to_quality, starter_need_score, prospect_role_fit cmd_s, sp_rp velo_leverage/tto_leakage)
classifications.why: Each component is DEFINED as a saturating linear ramp between two chosen calibration anchors -- there is no unbounded 'raw model z' underneath (unlike KRP+). The clamp IS the model output. The module is an explicit 0-100 SCREEN; a component >100 or <0 breaks the published 0-100 contract and the FIT's 0-100 semantics. The tail saturation is an intentional anchor (bb 0.05 == elite for the screen), not a compression artifact. The surface's own gate is rank-based on ~25 selected events with rho already sign-wrong, so it cannot authorize a de-clamp; the Monte-Carlo shows de-clamping is rank-~invariant (no board-movement win) -- REMOVE would only forfeit the contract for nothing.

classifications.clamp: outer _clamp on fb_reliance_inv / platoon_neutrality (inner fraction already bounds to [0,1]) and min(MAX_VELO_DELTA,...) in velo_delta (shape already clamped to [0,1])
classifications.disposition: KEEP (cosmetic; removal is byte-identical, not shipped)
classifications.why: These outer bounds never bind given the inner [0,1] clamp / shape clamp already present; removing them changes nothing. Pure belt-and-suspenders, left in place.

velo_delta is a Clemens-grounded physical projection (+-1.0 mph central, scaled to 2.2 for pure-power/thin-arsenal arms); 2.2 is the TOP of the literature range, hit exactly at shape=1. It is a model parameter, not a compression cap on a z, and it is DISPLAY-only (proj_velo, never a scored FIT input).
Domain bound on the published 0-100 FIT; binds only for fit>97. The nudge itself is a modeled additive, not a clamp.

The need-gate is the definition of SP->RP FIT ('a good starter is worth more than a good reliever'). The 0.30 floor is not tail compression -- REMOVING it makes the gate MORE aggressive (dominant starters -> 0), the opposite of de-compression. Retuning it is a model change, not a true-to-model de-clamp; the SP->RP direction is already downgraded, so there is no evidence base to retune. Untouched.
0.60 K% is a sanity ceiling (no pitcher whiffs 60% of PA); BB%>=0 is a rate floor. Display-only relief REM+ projection, never a FIT input.
A discrete arsenal-depth lookup, the role-structural signal; 100 for 4+ pitches is a natural ceiling (depth cannot exceed the arsenal).

classifications.disposition: KEEP (15) unless the sweep shows a raise is not-worse
classifications.why: Lower bound 1.0 is domain (a contract is >=1 yr). Upper bound 15 is the modern record term (Soto), already gate-raised 13->15. Predicting >15 yrs is pure extrapolation with ZERO training support (no contract exceeds 15 yrs). True-to-model would let the log-OLS print its raw term, so the years cap IS a served-vs-raw divergence -- the sweep adjudicates it on Gate 2 (pooled years/guarantee/aav + mega).

classifications.disposition: KEEP (load-bearing) unless the sweep shows loosening not-worse
classifications.why: The documented extrapolation backstop: unregularized/edge OLS blew up at megadeal extremes (Soto at $9M; 2019 over-explosions). Removing it risks re-breaking those; the sweep measures whether loosening/removing the 2.5x band worsens pooled guarantee/mega MAE.

Not a compression clamp: a smooth log-space blend toward the comps anchor as comps scale enters $50M-$400M+, with recorded monotone mega MAE (0.85:84.3 ... 1.00:80.1) and pooled improvement. Calibration, kept.

classifications.clamp: _decay_path WAR value floor max(0.0, rate*e/per); PT floor max(0,e)
classifications.why: PT>=0 is domain (no negative playing time). WAR value floored at 0 is the correct economic model for pricing production (a team benches/releases a sub-replacement season rather than pay negative) -- the sweep confirms unflooring does not help Gate 2.
sigma floor prevents a degenerate/zero-width log-normal (div-by-zero); the enter_prob itself is a CDF, naturally in [0,1] -- already true-to-model (no output clamp).
0.25 floors the log-rational argument off <=0 (log domain) for a near-zero-WAR player; prime-years and WAR floored at 0 are feature-domain bounds. Both are OLS feature inputs, not served metrics.

classifications.clamp: predict years=min(max(years,1),..); max(years,1) aav divisors; deal_verdict terciles 160/75
classifications.why: years>=1 and max(years,1) divisors are domain/div-by-zero guards. The deal_verdict 160/75 are empirical corpus TERCILE bins for a verdict STRING (a label boundary), not a clamp on the underlying Deal+.
Elapsed fraction is in (0,1]; the 0.05 floor prevents early-season div-by-tiny blowup, the 1.0 ceiling is definitional.

classifications.clamp: project_player rate floors max(0.0,rate)/pt; rate_path fip max(1.0); _assemble_hitter max(0,...); pt_risk clamp +-150/60
classifications.why: Component rates, PA/IP, hit counts cannot be negative; FIP<1 is non-physical (display). PT_RISK_CLAMP is an a-priori bound on a mean-zero injury redistribution and is default-OFF. All domain safety, none are z-compression.
Uses the nearest fitted age when the requested age is outside curve support (thin cohorts have holes) -- a support guard, not a metric compression.

findings: FA years upper cap (15): KEEP. Removing it is a TRADE-OFF, not a clean de-compression -- guarantee MAE -0.269 and mega -6.44 IMPROVE, but years MAE +0.053 and aav +0.007 WORSEN, because no real contract exceeds 15 yrs (the raw OLS term is out-of-support above 15). The served term should not exceed the all-time record; the guarantee gain is the guar-stage benefiting from an extrapolated years feature (a coupling artifact) -- flagged as a future DECOUPLING experiment, not a true-to-model de-clamp. Ready-to-flip constant MAX_PRED_YEARS provided (default 15, behavior-preserving).

FA comps-envelope guard (2.5x): KEEP -- ACCURACY-LOAD-BEARING (measured). Loosening monotonically worsens guarantee (removed +0.253) and mega (+5.53); independently confirms the documented megadeal-blowup backstop.

FA _decay_path WAR>=0 floor: KEEP -- removing it worsens ALL Gate-2 metrics (guar +0.030, aav +0.003, years +0.005, mega +0.36); the 0 floor is the correct economic model (bench/release a sub-replacement season, never pay negative).

PAL 0-100 component clamps: KEEP -- de-clamping (linear ramp extension) is rank-~invariant (rho clamped-vs-declamped RP->SP 0.9907, SP->RP 0.9863) so it buys NO board-movement, while breaking the published 0-100 SCREEN contract (declamped RP->SP FIT range [6.1, 110.3]). The gate is rank-based on ~25 sign-wrong events -- powerless to authorize a de-clamp. No true-to-model win.

NET C3a: no PAL/FA clamp is a removable board-movement/display-compression cap. Every one is numerical/domain safety, a bounded-screen definition, or accuracy-load-bearing (measured on the surface's own gate). Zero ships.
